stages.text: Play the story in order. Chapter trophies and named mission trophies unlock as the missions do, ending with the final mission and its gold trophy. Clear the missable trophies flagged in this guide before the finale, since some of their moments sit behind you by then.
stages.title: Story in order

stages.text: Side characters each have a strand of missions that ends with a final mission trophy. Take their jobs whenever their markers appear, and finish all six strands, including the eight stranger strands across Leonida.
stages.title: Side strands and strangers

stages.text: Try every activity type once, then work through the skill based trophies: shooting range golds, drone races, races, stunts and the partner and robbery challenges. Most of these can be done in free roam, and the two partner trophies need your partner beside you.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.text: Sweep the map region by region: meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK It locations, vehicles and all 52 areas of Leonida. Do this in one pass with the checklist open so nothing is left behind.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.text: Finish the money loop: rob bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations, launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and clear 50 challenges. Check the in game stats to see which count is short.
stages.title: Money and cleanup

stages.text: Attain 100 percent completion for the gold, and the platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. If the platinum has not popped, the progress bar at the top shows exactly which trophies are left.
stages.title: Platinum and 100 percent
